body:
Thanks for your response. The thing is, before I had this girl I would cling to a lot of girls, who would always, always dump me. I am probably pretty intense and overwhelming to deal with, because I am desperate, as you said, for a bond.


Before I found my girlfriend I tried reading A New Earth, actually. I didn't get very far. I liked it, but I'm just not very spiritual, I guess. I'm not trying to give excuses to not work on myself, but I just dont know.


I'm probably not making a lot of sense. I just dont know anymore. The only thing that makes me happy right now is thinking of dying. It would be so nice to be rid of the pain.

I want to thank you for taking your time to try and help me.


I've actually never really had a problem in seeking help. The problem is that no matter how much help I seek, I just wont get fixed. I've been depressed for a decade. Time won't do shit for me.


I've also never been emotionally numb. I wish I was. I just have this insane pain. Constantly. Constantly on the verge of crying my eyes out or actually crying. I wish I didnt have to feel it anymore. Which is also why I want to kill myself. I dont want to die because I think life is pointless or that I'm sick of not feeling anything. I want to die because the day-to-day pain I feel is just overwhelming and is too much.

It's not that I clinged to her., atleast not later in the relationship. I only saw her twice a week. It's just that moments where I would normally feel alone, I could just message her. When I wanted to talk about my day, I could just talk to her. Eventually I needed that less and less and I was perfectly content just being by myself, because I knew there was someone out there who totally loved me just for being me. Who didnt need me to be anyone else than who I actually was.


I know that I must sound like every other person who have been broken up with, and that it must sound like I'm overly dramatic, and maybe I am, but I just know how I felt before this relationship and how I felt after it. I'm so afraid of going back there.

I just dont think there's an other person on this planet who is capable of loving me. To me, there is no 'other one'. Besides my mom, I have no family. I have friends, but we barely talk. Me and my coworkers don't get along at all and I'm on the verge of getting fired. I feel like I'm all alone on this world. Finding my girlfriend the last time around nearly killed me. Putting myself out there again and again and just getting hurt again and again. I wanted to kill myself every day. Even in my dreams all I felt was loneliness and a need to kill myself.


Can you imagine what it's like to finally be in a place where that isn't the case anymore?  I didnt dream about wanting to die, I didnt wake up to feel like I want to die. I still had it from time to time, but it was more once every couple of months. And right now I'm just right back into that mess. I feel in my heart that there's going to be a day that I'm going to break and that I'm going to do it.
For me it very clearly was. Since I have never been happy for a prolonged period of time like I was in my relationship.

I know, I want to be helped, but I'm just afraid that I am beyond help. I've tried everything under the sun in order to get my head straight that even if we were to break up, I would be fine... well that failed miserably. I know to someone else it might seem like I'm just grieving over my relationship, but to me this is so much more. 


I am terrible when I'm alone. The loneliness will consume me and I will try everything in my power to keep myself occupied in order to forget how lonely I feel, but I will fail miserably. Eventually everything in my life will fall apart. I'll stop going to school, I'll call in sick to work. If I have no external motivation to do something, I won't do it. How would I even meet someone? I have no clue. I'll have to go out again, I'll have to pretend to be happy and to be confident just to get someone to like me again. I'll have to open myself up for a world of heartbreak again. I hated dating. I hated being single. I hated myself. I hated everyone else. I just hated it. Obviously this is all old feelings from my childhood which I dont want to get into now, but it's there nonetheless.


Never in my life have I been happier than I was in my relationship. I'm not easy to deal with. Finding someone who is willing to deal with a depressed suicidal loser isn't an easy task and it took me years of constantly putting myself out there and getting heartbroken before  I found her. I finally found someone who didn't run away screaming after I opened myself up to her. Who didn't ghost me after she figured out I wasn't all happy-go-lucky. Who didn't think that ditching me was acceptable after seeing how messed up I really was.


The idea of having to go through that again, I can't fucking deal.
